title: Weak Epp solution through normalized branches
statement: Let $X,Y$ be commutative rings, let $P,Q,H$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension], and give maps $X\to Y$, $X\to P$, $Y\to Q$, $P\to Q$, $P\to H$ such that the two composites $X\to Q$ agree. Give $H$ its composite $X$-algebra structure. Set $R_H=\operatorname{IntCl}_X(H)$ and $C_H=\operatorname{IntCl}_Y((Q\otimes_P H)_{\mathrm{red}})$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure, def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], where reduction is quotient by the nilradical. The canonical map $f:R_H\to C_H$ sends $h$ to the image of $1\otimes h$. Define the normalized weak-solution predicate to mean that $H/P$ is finite-dimensional and, for every maximal ideal $q$ of $C_H$, its contraction $n=f^{-1}(q)$ is maximal, both $(R_H)_n$ and $(C_H)_q$ are discrete valuation rings [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], and $n(C_H)_q=q(C_H)_q$. When $X\to Y$ is an injective local map of DVRs with fraction fields $P\subseteq Q$ and the specified maps are the induced ones, this is the weak-solution notion of Stacks Tag 09EN.
